mapper.insert: insert into issue_relationships(tenant_id,relationship_id,from_task_issue_link_id,to_task_issue_link_id,relationship_type,provider_relation_id,sync_status,payload_hash,idempotency_key,last_error_code,last_error_message,resource_version,created_at,updated_at) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.relationshipId},#{value.fromTaskIssueLinkId},#{value.toTaskIssueLinkId},#{value.relationshipType},#{value.providerRelationId},#{value.syncStatus},#{value.payloadHash},#{value.idempotencyKey},#{value.lastErrorCode},#{value.lastErrorMessage},#{value.resourceVersion},#{value.createdAt},#{value.updatedAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,relationship_id) do update set provider_relation_id=coalesce(excluded.provider_relation_id,issue_relationships.provider_relation_id),sync_status=excluded.sync_status,last_error_code=excluded.last_error_code,last_error_message=excluded.last_error_message,resource_version=issue_relationships.resource_version+1,updated_at=now()
